name: Lookout [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your allies help you avoid being surprised.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally may act in the surprise round as long as you would normally be able to act in the surprise round. If your ally would normally be denied the ability to act in the surprise round, their initiative is equal to your initiative roll or the roll of your ally –1, whichever is lower. If both you and your ally would be able to act in the surprise round without the aid of this feat, your ally may take both a standard and a move action (or a full?round action) during the surprise round.
